evidence.title: No PII patterns or allowlist system exists

The 8 vulnerability patterns (hardcoded_secret, http_body_leak, sql_injection, cors_wildcard, missing_input_validation, info_disclosure, missing_timeouts, debug_code) contain nothing PII-related. No path-based exemption system exists. This confirms the gap analysis in Findings 2-3 is accurate.
